name: Tom Sojer
beschreibung: The Hotel Tom Sojer is centrally located in Ellmau, a vibrant village in the Tyrolean Lowlands at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser mountains. The setting provides easy access to hiking paths and the expansive Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area. The hotel exudes understated alpine elegance. Guests can look forward to attentive personal service and hearty regional cuisine. Dedicated parking spaces and an inviting terrace are also available.
